question: In what directional order should the placement proceed when addressed to the Kulanāyikā?
premises: The sequence begins at the right side
The sequence ends at the left side
The instruction is directed to Kulanāyikā
inference: One should place the elements from the right side to the left end, O Kulanāyikā.
plain_english: O Kulanāyikā, one should place them beginning from the right side and ending at the left.
